text_block_list.text:
One day, after running countless races 
with Haru Urara—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho, heave-ho...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm done running! What should I 
do next!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yes!

Lately, Haru Urara has been working even 
harder than usual. I'd like to give her 
some kind of reward, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I want a reward~! The hot springs will be 
my reward!
...Oh right, there was a reward!
choice_data_list:
Urara, ready to head to the hot springs 
soon?

Urara, ready to head to the hot springs 
soon?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring trip!? I wanna go, I wanna 
gooo!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: But why?
choice_data_list: The prize I won in the raffle...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Mmm~? A lottery... what was that again?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get what's going on, but 
I'm so happy about the reward hot spring 
trip!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Re-ward, re-waaard, Urara-ran-ran♪
choice_data_list:
Why don't you go invite some friends, 
then?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh, why's that?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to the hot springs with my 
Trainer!
And so, in the blink of an eye—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~♪ That was such a wonderful bath, 
wasn't it~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you get to relax properly? 
Did you float around all nice and lazily~?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: *staaaaaaaare...*

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You're right, your cheeks are bright red! 
That's proof you soaked properly all the 
way up to your shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Then next time, I'm coming over to hang 
out in your room, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you a shoulder massage! It's 
super popular at home, you know!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're always working so hard, 
good job! Here's a shoulder massage to 
reward you~.
choice_data_list: I appreciate the thought, but why?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Today's a reward day for me, and... for 
you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Because if I worked super hard, then 
Trainer must have done the exact same!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So today, the two of us are gonna treat 
each other to rewards!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So I'll give you a shoulder massage~, and 
tell you lots of fun stories!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer is, well... ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
As long as you give me lots of smiles, 
that's all the reward I need!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Eheh...♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's enjoy our reward, Trainer!

Even after that, I enjoyed the reward at a 
relaxed, easygoing pace with Haru Urara.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Haru Urara and 
myself...
